source_authority.relationship: The annex decomposes but does not supersede the canonical Atlas. CAD-001..CAD-069 are integration-owned parent IDs, not canonical Atlas IDs.

parents.source_title: RFQ, drawing, document, and model intake
parents.minimum_credible_proof: Ingest a synthetic mixed packet; preserve originals/hashes; extract requirements, assumptions, unknowns, and model/drawing links with human correction.
parents.architecture_action_source: **BUILD—simplify** intake/evidence objects; **INTEGRATE** document/CAD parsers.

parents.source_title: Requirements, scenarios, constraints, acceptance and verification method
parents.minimum_credible_proof: Versioned requirement objects with source spans, owner, verification method, acceptance criterion, uncertainty, and approval state.
parents.architecture_action_source: **BUILD—simplify** the lifecycle spine; **INTEGRATE** domain solvers; **REJECT** automatic legal conclusions.

parents.source_title: Requirement-to-feature/model trace
parents.minimum_credible_proof: A parameter/feature change shows exact upstream requirement and downstream BOM/process/test impact; broken links fail visibly.
parents.architecture_action_source: **BUILD** stable typed links and change impact; **DEFER** broad systems-engineering authoring.

parents.source_title: Product structure, part identity, configurations, revisioned BOM
parents.minimum_credible_proof: Stable item IDs, configured BOM, quantity/source/effectivity, version/revision distinction, where-used, and reproducible export.
parents.architecture_action_source: **BUILD—simplify** first product record; **INTEGRATE** later with authoritative PLM/ERP.

parents.source_title: Make/buy, supplier question, sourcing state, cost and lead time
parents.minimum_credible_proof: Each BOM line has make/buy, source/confidence/as-of date, approved alternative state, estimate provenance, and explicit unknowns.
parents.architecture_action_source: **BUILD—simplify** decision/state fields; **INTEGRATE** live supplier/ERP data; **REJECT** fabricated quotes.

parents.source_title: Process plan, routing, tooling and work instructions
parents.minimum_credible_proof: Revision-bound operations, resources, inputs/outputs, media, safety/review gates, and change-impact warning on stale instructions.
parents.architecture_action_source: **BUILD—simplify** a low-volume plan/instruction flow; **INTEGRATE** CAM/MES; **DEFER** factory scheduling.

parents.source_title: Build/WIP, serial-lot and as-built genealogy
parents.minimum_credible_proof: One synthetic unit records consumed revisions/lots, operator/agent, timestamps, deviations, and immutable links to instructions/results.
parents.architecture_action_source: **BUILD** traceable demo state; **INTEGRATE** MES later; **REJECT** machine/PLC control in hackathon scope.

parents.source_title: Inspection, test, nonconformance and deviation
parents.minimum_credible_proof: Characteristics link to model/requirement; actuals retain instrument/method/unit/actor; failures block release; deviation needs named approval.
parents.architecture_action_source: **BUILD—simplify** evidence/gates; **INTEGRATE** CMM/test/QMS; **REJECT** certification inference.

parents.source_title: Authorized release and immutable release packet
parents.minimum_credible_proof: Separate requested/authorized/applied/verified states; exact neutral geometry, drawing/PMI, BOM, process, inspection, approvals, hashes, runtimes, and parent revision.
parents.architecture_action_source: **BUILD** core release/receipt layer; **INTEGRATE** enterprise PLM/archive.

parents.source_title: Operational feedback back to requirement/design
parents.minimum_credible_proof: A field/test observation becomes a sourced finding, triggers triage, and produces an authorized requirement/design change without overwriting history.
parents.architecture_action_source: **BUILD** a minimal feedback/finding object; **INTEGRATE** service/QMS systems later.

parents.source_title: 2D sketch entities, trim/extend, projection, construction geometry
parents.minimum_credible_proof: Create/edit a golden sketch; entity IDs survive non-destructive edits and replay.
parents.architecture_action_source: **BUILD** bounded basics; **BORROW** solver/geometry primitives; **DEFER** long tail.

parents.source_title: Dimensions, geometric constraints, under/full/over states and diagnostics
parents.minimum_credible_proof: Solved, under-constrained, redundant, and contradictory fixtures report residual DOF and actionable conflicting constraints deterministically.
parents.architecture_action_source: **BUILD** solver boundary/diagnostics; **BORROW** compatible solver after license/robustness test.

parents.source_title: Advanced sketch patterns, blocks, splines and 3D sketching
parents.minimum_credible_proof: Create/edit each claimed construct; preserve associativity and constraints through pattern/member edits.
parents.architecture_action_source: **DEFER** except what the canonical bracket fixture needs.

parents.source_title: Parametric solid features: extrude/revolve/sweep/loft/hole/shell/draft/rib/pattern/mirror/boolean/fillet/chamfer
parents.minimum_credible_proof: Golden parts validate shape, volume, area, topology counts and tolerances before/after driving edits.
parents.architecture_action_source: **BORROW** exact kernel; **BUILD** feature graph for sketch, extrude and one edge treatment; **DEFER** breadth.

parents.source_title: Variables/equations, feature history, suppress/reorder, rollback and recompute
parents.minimum_credible_proof: Clean-state deterministic replay; failed downstream reference identifies operation and preserves last-valid artifact; rollback/restore is lossless.
parents.architecture_action_source: **BUILD** core operation graph, stable IDs, migration, diagnostics and last-valid recovery.

parents.source_title: Direct edit/push-pull/move or delete-heal face
parents.minimum_credible_proof: Edit an imported historyless B-rep; validate exact shape and explicit parameter/history record.
parents.architecture_action_source: **BORROW** kernel primitives; **DEFER** broad UI; never call render-mesh edits exact CAD.

parents.source_title: Surface/NURBS creation, trim/extend/knit/fill/thicken and continuity
parents.minimum_credible_proof: Rebuild a watertight fixture; report gaps and requested G0/G1/G2 continuity with tolerance checks.
parents.architecture_action_source: **BORROW** kernel primitives; **DEFER** professional authoring environment.

parents.source_title: Subdivision/T-Spline/freeform cage modeling
parents.minimum_credible_proof: Cage edits remain editable; conversion yields declared continuity/watertightness and survives downstream operations.
parents.architecture_action_source: **DEFER**; do not confuse desktop face deformation or mesh display with Sub-D authoring.

parents.source_title: Mesh repair/conversion, hybrid modeling, reverse engineering and point clouds
parents.minimum_credible_proof: Import, diagnose, repair and convert known defective meshes with measured deviation; point-cloud workflow names preprocessing and retained reference semantics.
parents.architecture_action_source: **INTEGRATE** import/reference; **BORROW** conversion where licensed; **DEFER** reverse-engineering suite.

parents.source_title: Configurations, model states, design variants and variant BOM
parents.minimum_credible_proof: One canonical model produces named variants, correct feature/component suppression, BOMs and release identity without hidden file forks.
parents.architecture_action_source: **BUILD** parameter/variant exploration and configuration schema; **DEFER** full family-table UX.

parents.source_title: Bottom-up, top-down, in-context and skeletal assembly design
parents.minimum_credible_proof: Assembly references update predictably; circular/stale contexts fail visibly; imported hierarchy retains stable component identity.
parents.architecture_action_source: **BUILD** product/assembly data model and viewer; **INTEGRATE** imported structure; **DEFER** full authoring.

parents.source_title: Mates/joints, DOF, limits and mechanical relations
parents.minimum_credible_proof: Known mechanisms solve correct DOF and limits; invalid/overconstrained relations identify the conflict.
parents.architecture_action_source: **DEFER** full solver; **BUILD** typed relation schema only when required.

parents.source_title: Kinematic mechanisms, drive/animate, springs/dampers/loads
parents.minimum_credible_proof: Sweep full range, detect singular/invalid states, and distinguish kinematic animation from force/dynamic simulation.
parents.architecture_action_source: **DEFER**; **INTEGRATE** validated motion solver later.

parents.source_title: Interference/clearance, explode, assembly BOM and flexible subassemblies
parents.minimum_credible_proof: Known interference and clearance fixtures; exploded state and BOM remain revision/configuration-correct.
parents.architecture_action_source: **BUILD** viewer/BOM basics; **INTEGRATE** exact assembly solving; **DEFER** authoring breadth.

parents.source_title: Large-assembly loading, simplification and performance
parents.minimum_credible_proof: Declare component/body/triangle target; measure load, rotate, select, update and memory; deferred loading cannot omit released structure silently.
parents.architecture_action_source: **DEFER** optimization breadth; set explicit performance envelope and fail honestly.

parents.source_title: Associative drawings, sections/details, dimensions, symbols, tables, balloons, title/revision blocks
parents.minimum_credible_proof: Edit model/configuration and prove every view/table/balloon updates or becomes explicitly stale; export declared PDF/DWG.
parents.architecture_action_source: **BUILD** browser review/markup; **INTEGRATE/DEFER** production drawing generation.

parents.source_title: GD&T: datums, FCFs, surface finish and weld symbols
parents.minimum_credible_proof: Author/render a toleranced fixture under an exact ASME/ISO revision; invalid syntax rejected; human interpretation and semantic data tested separately.
parents.architecture_action_source: **DEFER** authoring/standards validation; preserve/inspect imported metadata.

parents.source_title: Semantic PMI/MBD, inspection characteristics and tolerance analysis
parents.minimum_credible_proof: NIST/CAx-IF fixture round-trip preserves semantic and graphic PMI, views, units and validation properties; tolerance result has auditable chain.
parents.architecture_action_source: **INTEGRATE** PMI preservation/inspection; **DEFER** authoring/validation and tolerance solver.

parents.source_title: Sheet metal, unfold/refold, flat patterns, bend rules/tables and DXF
parents.minimum_credible_proof: Folded-to-flat fixture validates neutral axis/bend allowance, corners, grain and DXF dimensions; round trip does not double-bend.
parents.architecture_action_source: **INTEGRATE** flat pattern/import/export first; **DEFER** authoring.

parents.source_title: Weldments, frames, structural members, end treatments and cut lists
parents.minimum_credible_proof: Frame updates from skeleton; miters/end treatments and cut list lengths/quantities remain correct across revision.
parents.architecture_action_source: **DEFER**; **INTEGRATE** standard libraries/generators later.

parents.source_title: Mold/tooling: draft/undercut, parting, core/cavity, runners/cooling and plastics
parents.minimum_credible_proof: Known molded part yields valid split/core/cavity and draft/undercut report; analysis names external solver/version/benchmark.
parents.architecture_action_source: **DEFER** mold authoring; **INTEGRATE** validated plastics solver.

parents.source_title: Tube, pipe, hose and duct routing with fittings/cut lengths
parents.minimum_credible_proof: Connectivity graph, bend/min-radius checks, fittings, cut lengths and route BOM survive change/rebuild.
parents.architecture_action_source: **DEFER**; preserve imported structure and **INTEGRATE** specialist tools.

parents.source_title: Cable/harness/electrical routing, connectors, wire lengths and nailboards
parents.minimum_credible_proof: Import connectivity, route physically, compute wire lengths/BOM, and generate a revision-bound nailboard with connector identity.
parents.architecture_action_source: **DEFER**; preserve imported structure and **INTEGRATE** ECAD/routing.

parents.source_title: STEP AP203/AP214/AP242 import/export
parents.minimum_credible_proof: Header records AP/version; NIST fixtures compare shape, units, hierarchy, names/colors, semantic/graphic PMI and validation properties in both directions.
parents.architecture_action_source: **BORROW** OCCT STEP; **BUILD** receipts/fixtures; **INTEGRATE** licensed translators; never claim all AP242 semantics.

parents.source_title: IGES, Parasolid, ACIS/SAT, JT and native CAD references
parents.minimum_credible_proof: Per format/direction/version: shape validity, healing log, assembly/reference behavior, units, metadata and update semantics.
parents.architecture_action_source: **BORROW** open neutral support; **INTEGRATE** proprietary/licensed adapters; **DEFER** native editability.

parents.source_title: DWG/DXF import/export
parents.minimum_credible_proof: State AutoCAD target version; test model/paper space, layers, blocks, text, linetypes, units, curves and sheet-metal flat geometry both directions.
parents.architecture_action_source: **INTEGRATE** mature adapter; **DEFER** full DWG authoring. DWG is proprietary, not neutral.

parents.source_title: STL/OBJ mesh exchange
parents.minimum_credible_proof: State binary/ASCII, units and tessellation tolerance; compare watertightness, normals, triangle count and deviation.
parents.architecture_action_source: **BUILD/BORROW** bounded export; treat as derivative, never geometry authority.

parents.source_title: 3MF core and extensions
parents.minimum_credible_proof: Validate core conformance and list each supported extension/direction; materials, production, beam, slice, security and volumetric are separate claims.
parents.architecture_action_source: **INTEGRATE/BORROW** library; **DEFER** extensions not fixture-tested.

parents.source_title: glTF/GLB, USDZ and AR/VR delivery
parents.minimum_credible_proof: Scene/node/material/animation fixture plus device test; explicitly prove this is a derivative with no authoring/history semantics.
parents.architecture_action_source: **BORROW** viewer/export; **DEFER** AR authoring; **REJECT** glTF as canonical CAD.

parents.source_title: Rendering, PBR/ray tracing, animation and technical communication
parents.minimum_credible_proof: Reproducible scene/camera/material/light settings, render runtime, animation limits, and source-revision link.
parents.architecture_action_source: **BORROW** generic rendering; **BUILD** review/section/measure; **DEFER** photorealistic suite.

parents.source_title: 2D/2.5D and 3-axis milling/drilling
parents.minimum_credible_proof: Stock/workholding/tool/library, feeds/speeds, rest material, gouge/collision checks, post identity and independent toolpath comparison.
parents.architecture_action_source: **BORROW** visual experiment only; **DEFER** production NC pending independent validation.

parents.source_title: 3+2, simultaneous 4-axis and 5-axis machining
parents.minimum_credible_proof: Machine kinematics, singularities, limits, retract/rewind, fixtures and verified post on representative parts.
parents.architecture_action_source: **DEFER**; **INTEGRATE** validated CAM.

parents.source_title: Turning, mill-turn and Swiss
parents.minimum_credible_proof: Lathe/mill-turn setup, spindle/channel synchronization, stock transfer, holder collision and controller-specific post verification.
parents.architecture_action_source: **DEFER**; **INTEGRATE** validated CAM.

parents.source_title: Additive orientation, supports, slicing/toolpaths, process simulation and machine output
parents.minimum_credible_proof: Name process/machine/material; validate orientation/support/slice/build file and extension semantics; benchmark process simulation separately.
parents.architecture_action_source: **BUILD** STL derivative only; **INTEGRATE** slicer; **DEFER** advanced additive.

parents.source_title: 2D/3D nesting and utilization reports
parents.minimum_credible_proof: Known sheet/build set reproduces orientation/grain/spacing constraints, quantity, utilization, remnant and DXF/NC handoff.
parents.architecture_action_source: **DEFER**; **INTEGRATE** specialist nesting.

parents.source_title: Probing, part alignment and inspection
parents.minimum_credible_proof: Probe qualification, work offset/alignment, characteristic linkage, uncertainty, post support and captured actuals; distinguish manual/CMM/on-machine.
parents.architecture_action_source: **INTEGRATE** validated inspection; **DEFER** native cycles.

parents.source_title: Toolpath/machine simulation, collision, post-processing and NC output
parents.minimum_credible_proof: Controller/machine/post pinned; independent backplot and collision suite; physical dry run under qualified review before any safety claim.
parents.architecture_action_source: **REJECT** unverified production NC and machine control; **INTEGRATE** validated providers later.

parents.source_title: Linear static FEA
parents.minimum_credible_proof: Published benchmark, units/material/contact/load audit, mesh convergence, reactions and independent comparison with solver/runtime recorded.
parents.architecture_action_source: **INTEGRATE** solver; **BUILD** mass properties/simple checks only; no accuracy claim without benchmark.

parents.source_title: Modal/frequency, buckling, fatigue and drop
parents.minimum_credible_proof: One accepted benchmark per named study; mode normalization/constraints and fatigue/drop assumptions explicit.
parents.architecture_action_source: **INTEGRATE/DEFER**; claim each study separately.

parents.source_title: Steady/transient thermal and thermal stress
parents.minimum_credible_proof: Energy-balance and analytical benchmarks, temperature-dependent material data, contacts/convection/radiation and convergence.
parents.architecture_action_source: **INTEGRATE** validated solver; **DEFER** authoring.

parents.source_title: Nonlinear static, linear/nonlinear dynamics and impact
parents.minimum_credible_proof: Benchmark large displacement/material/contact/time integration; solver tolerances and nonconvergence must fail visibly.
parents.architecture_action_source: **INTEGRATE/DEFER**; **REJECT** visually inferred validity.

parents.source_title: Dynamic motion/multibody simulation
parents.minimum_credible_proof: Benchmark joints, mass/inertia, forces, contacts and energy; distinguish animation/kinematics from dynamics.
parents.architecture_action_source: **INTEGRATE/DEFER**.

parents.source_title: General CFD and electronics cooling
parents.minimum_credible_proof: Canonical flow/heat benchmark, mesh independence, conservation, turbulence/boundary audit; electronics model/component power provenance.
parents.architecture_action_source: **INTEGRATE** validated providers; **DEFER** native workflow.

parents.source_title: Plastics/injection and composites
parents.minimum_credible_proof: Published fill/pack/warp or laminate benchmark; material database/version and process assumptions explicit.
parents.architecture_action_source: **INTEGRATE/DEFER**.

parents.source_title: Topology/shape optimization and generative outcomes
parents.minimum_credible_proof: Loads/constraints/manufacturing methods/objectives pinned; compare outcomes; prove editability; do not rename parameter sweeps generative engineering.
parents.architecture_action_source: **DEFER** generative; **BUILD** bounded parameter/variant exploration without overclaim.

parents.source_title: Schematic capture, PCB layout/routing, libraries, DRC and manufacturing outputs
parents.minimum_credible_proof: Schematic-board synchronization, net/variant consistency, DRC, BOM, Gerber/drill/assembly outputs and revision-bound enclosure link.
parents.architecture_action_source: **REJECT** native ECAD authoring; **INTEGRATE** files/viewers/tools.

parents.source_title: SPICE and signal-integrity analysis
parents.minimum_credible_proof: Published circuit benchmark, model/library provenance, simulator/version and analysis settings; SI treated separately.
parents.architecture_action_source: **REJECT** native SPICE/SI; **INTEGRATE** established tools.

parents.source_title: MCAD/ECAD synchronization and enclosure/cooling handoff
parents.minimum_credible_proof: Round-trip board outline, component positions, keep-ins/outs, connector identity, conflicts and revision ownership; cooling is separately validated.
parents.architecture_action_source: **INTEGRATE**; preserve typed references and receipts.

parents.source_title: Automatic versions/history, compare and restore
parents.minimum_credible_proof: Every saved result has immutable parent, actor, timestamp and artifact hashes; compare/restore reproduces the exact state.
parents.architecture_action_source: **BUILD** core model history/provenance/restore.

parents.source_title: Branch, propose, semantic diff, review, merge and deterministic replay
parents.minimum_credible_proof: Concurrent proposals never overwrite; noncommutative geometry conflicts are explicit; accepted operations replay cleanly with stable IDs.
parents.architecture_action_source: **BUILD** primary differentiator; **BORROW** presence only, not geometry merge.

parents.source_title: Identity, permissions, search, part numbering, where-used and BOM control
parents.minimum_credible_proof: Role/object/state permission tests; immutable item identity; search/where-used and BOM rollup reflect exact revision/configuration.
parents.architecture_action_source: **BUILD—simplify** minimum controls; **INTEGRATE** enterprise PDM/PLM later.

parents.source_title: ECR/ECO, lifecycle, approval, release and PLM/ERP/MES APIs
parents.minimum_credible_proof: State machine, separation of duties, affected-items/where-used, signed approval, revision transition and idempotent integration receipt.
parents.architecture_action_source: **BUILD** bounded release gate; **INTEGRATE** enterprise transactions; **DEFER** full PLM.

parents.source_title: Presence, comments, markup, share/review, tasks and concurrent editing
parents.minimum_credible_proof: Two users edit/review; presence and comments are revision-bound; offline/stale client cannot silently overwrite; conflict is recoverable.
parents.architecture_action_source: **BORROW** presence/comments; **BUILD** semantic authorization/conflict layer.

parents.source_title: Public API, webhooks, batch conversion and headless execution
parents.minimum_credible_proof: Versioned API contract, auth/scope, idempotency, rate/error semantics, pinned runtime and deterministic headless golden replay.
parents.architecture_action_source: **BUILD** typed operation API/receipts; **INTEGRATE** vendor APIs; **DEFER** generic compatibility.

parents.source_title: Scripts, macros, custom features, rules, plug-ins and extensions
parents.minimum_credible_proof: Sandboxed/versioned extension manifest, permissions, deterministic fixture, migration and failure isolation; no arbitrary code in canonical record.
parents.architecture_action_source: **BUILD** constrained rules/typed operations; **INTEGRATE** ecosystems; **REJECT** ungoverned mutation.

parents.source_title: Desktop, browser and mobile authoring/review
parents.minimum_credible_proof: Cold-user task on each claimed client; state/edit parity and client limitations documented; mobile review tested separately from authoring.
parents.architecture_action_source: **BUILD** browser workbench/mobile review; **DEFER** broad mobile authoring.

parents.source_title: Offline work, autosave, crash/disconnect recovery and backup
parents.minimum_credible_proof: Malformed operation, worker crash, disconnect, stale client and restore drill retain last-valid state and identify unsynced changes.
parents.architecture_action_source: **BUILD** last-valid recovery/audit; **BORROW** metadata offline; **DEFER** full offline geometry collaboration.

parents.source_title: Security/admin: roles, SSO, encryption, tenant/region controls and audit export
parents.minimum_credible_proof: Threat model and control tests; certification/scope document tied to exact service/deployment; access/audit/export/revocation drills.
parents.architecture_action_source: **BUILD** fail-closed auth, privacy and audit; **INTEGRATE** identity; **DEFER** enterprise certifications/regions.

parents.source_title: Human/agent parity, mutation authorization and receipts
parents.minimum_credible_proof: Same typed operation for human/agent; requested, authorized, applied, verified and rolled-back states are distinct; local/cloud credentials scoped; denied action leaves no mutation.
parents.architecture_action_source: **BUILD** core differentiator; **REJECT** ambient or unaudited agent authority.
